name: invoices-item-en
expected_behavior: Resolves the customer's CardCode and the item's ItemCode with live queries, and the receipt shows those resolved codes or names
The proposed document (receipt or payload) is an item-type AR invoice (Invoices, ItemCode + Quantity 2 on the line), not a service invoice
Does not hardcode or invent a VatGroup/tax code; leaves it to SAP or resolves it live
Shows a confirmation receipt (customer, item, quantity, price/total) and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
Does not create a SAP draft (sap_b1_create_draft), since the user did not ask for one
